category: message queue broker: a vhost on a shared LavinMQ broker

free_tier.stated: Loyal Lemming: 2 M messages a month, 40 connections, max 200 queues and max 20 000 queued messages on a shared LavinMQ broker, free for as long as the instance is used, no card
free_tier.notes: The quota counts messages: a message counts once when it is published and once when it is consumed, so 2 M a month is about 1,000,000 messages that are both published and consumed. The monthly count of shared instances resets on the first day of each month, and warning emails go out at 70 and 100 percent. At the connection limit new connections are refused and existing ones stay up. Shared plans allow 200 channels per connection. An account may hold up to 49 free instances (650 once it has a paid instance), Little Lemur and Loyal Lemming together.

per_object_cap.stated: 128 MB per message on LavinMQ (written 128mb), configurable
per_object_cap.notes: The page writes 128mb without saying whether it means MB or MiB, so no byte count is recorded.

retention.stated: A free instance with no message published or consumed during the latest two months is deleted after a warning email; the plans page lists no idle-queue limit for Loyal Lemming
retention.notes: Activity-based: an instance survives as long as messages move, and the warning email offers to wake the instance up. Whether the 28-day idle-queue deletion of the shared RabbitMQ plans also applies on shared LavinMQ is unverified: the plans page lists it only for the RabbitMQ plans.

egress.terms: Data transfer is included within a fair-use allowance equal to 30% of the team's monthly spend; usage above it may be charged after a 30-day grace period
egress.free_allowance: unverified: the allowance is stated as 30% of team spend, and no page states a figure for a team that holds only free instances

interface_detail: Broker protocols AMQP 0-9-1, MQTT, HTTP and WebSockets; LavinMQ supports neither AMQP 1.0 nor STOMP. The interface vocabulary has no term for AMQP, MQTT or WebSocket, so they are listed here. The shared plans include streams, webhooks (push-queues) and the built-in delayed message exchange of LavinMQ. Instances, teams and keys are managed through the CloudAMQP Customer API at https://customer.cloudamqp.com/api, which answers 401 without an API key.
tooling: Any AMQP 0-9-1 client library, many RabbitMQ-compatible ones included, an MQTT client, the CloudAMQP Customer API with an API key as the HTTP basic password and an empty username, and the cloudamqp Terraform provider, which names the plan lemming.
chaining: A durable work queue between a scheduler that publishes jobs and free compute workers that consume them, sized for about 66,667 message events a day; the larger of the two free CloudAMQP shared plans.

limits.value: 2 M messages per month, counted on publish and on consume, reset on the first day of the month
instance deleted after two months with no message published or consumed

limits_note: 40 concurrent connections, max 200 queues and max 20 000 queued messages per instance, and 200 channels per connection. At the connection limit new connections are refused. The vocabulary has no kind for a concurrency or a backlog cap.
binding_note: 2 M messages a month is about 66,667 a day (2,000,000 / 30), and a message that is published and consumed counts twice, so a steady job queue meets the monthly count before the 40-connection or 20 000-message backlog caps.

identity_cost.detail: The signup page asks for an email address, or a GitHub or Google sign-in, and an email signup is confirmed by a link sent to the inbox; the plans page states no credit card is required for the free shared plans. Whether a later step asks for a phone number is unverified: behind a sign-up.

reliability_note: A free instance with no message published or consumed for two months is deleted after a warning email; a Lemming instance is a vhost on a multi-tenant LavinMQ broker that shares hardware with other instances, and the vendor lists the shared plans as not recommended for production because of variable performance.
confidence_note: Every limit is quoted from a first-party page; the management API host was probed and answered 401 without a key. No broker connection was made, because a broker URL exists only inside an account. A probe of an AMQPS connection with an account's URL would move it to measured.
notes: The other free CloudAMQP shared plan, Little Lemur on RabbitMQ, has half the quota and is a separate record. Paid shared LavinMQ (Elegant Ermine) is USD 19 a month for 20 M messages, 200 connections, max 2000 queues and max 200 000 queued messages. A shared LavinMQ instance can move to a single-node dedicated LavinMQ plan from the console, and it gets a new hostname.
